## The study

This site reproduces the regional maps from published heart-transplantation studies that used the UNOS registry [@madan2021hcv; @madan2024dcd; @madan2025evmp], and teaches how to draw them with the sRtr package [@srtr_package]. The maps' values come from the published analyses and are public.

-   **Shivank Madan** (principal investigator of the studies)
-   **Vagish Hemmige** (mapping and code)

Scientific decisions are made by the people named in [`AGENTS.md`](agents.qmd); open ones are listed in `SETUP-NOTES.md` until they are filed in [Issues](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/UNOS-mapping/issues).

## This repository

`R/main.R` runs the scripts in order: setup, shared map layers, then one script per study. The region geography and transplant centers come from sRtr. Each study's regional counts, published in its paper, are written out in its script. The original RMDs are kept unchanged in `original/`.

Contributions follow the rules in [`AGENTS.md`](agents.qmd).

## How this website was created

The site is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) from the scripts themselves. Each code page imports the labelled sections of its script from `R/` and shows them with an explanation; the site never runs the analysis.

The repository was set up with the R Analysis Workflow plugin and an AI assistant (Claude), working on branches and through pull requests reviewed by the maintainer.

Four documents describe the project. In short: the plan is the scientific intent, the architecture is the workflow as implemented, and `AGENTS.md` holds the rules for working together.

-   [**Analysis plan**](analysis-plan.qmd): *what the maps are meant to show, and why.*
-   [**Architecture**](architecture.qmd): *how the code does it.*
-   [**AGENTS.md**](agents.qmd): *how people and AI assistants work on the project.*
-   [**Repository blueprint**](repository-blueprint.qmd): *the layout every project of this kind starts from.*

## Pages

-   [**Clinical background**](background.qmd): the three studies and why each mapped regional variation.
-   [**Methodological background**](methodological_background.qmd): an introduction to mapping in R (sf, projections, choropleths, tmap and insets), pointing to Walker's *Analyzing US Census Data*.
-   [**Study design and methods**](study_methods.qmd): what the maps show and the choices behind them, in plain language.
-   [**Setup**](setup.qmd): packages and shared constants.
-   [**Functions**](functions.qmd): reading summaries, choosing centers, and drawing the ggplot2 and tmap maps.
-   [**1. Map geography**](map_geography.qmd): regions, outlines, labels, centers and the inset extent, shared by every study.
-   [**2. HCV donors (2021)**](hcv_map.qmd): the HCV-donor maps.
-   [**3. DCD donors (2024)**](dcd_map.qmd): the four DCD-donor maps.
-   [**4. Machine perfusion (2025)**](evmp_map.qmd): the machine-perfusion map.
-   [**Original RMDs**](original_code.qmd): the code that drew the published maps.
-   [**Maps**](results.qmd): every study's maps, in both versions.
